informal_statement: For \(0<\lambda<1\) and \(R\geq0\), \(\beta_\lambda(R)\) is an admissible type-\(\mathrm B\) angle.
reason: `CMVBallCase.lean:183-199`: The source assumes \(0\leq R\), not \(R>0\), and proves both admissibility inequalities. Its comparison with the zero-radius arctangent gives the stated upper endpoint and includes \(R=0\).
